environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured; a personal machine with separate personal, work, and per-client contexts
**Cloud provider(s)**: AWS credentials exist at ~/.aws (Read-denied in permissions; treat as sensitive and never read or share them); no cloud deploy targets configured

**Repository visibility**: PUBLIC; $HOME is the tracked dotfiles repo gabrielecanepa/dotfiles (github.com:gabrielecanepa/dotfiles.git), and this settings file itself is tracked there, so tracked files never receive secrets or machine-specific identifiers
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured; treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: 1Password (app plus SSH agent socket); its group containers, the macOS Keychain, and ~/.claude/.credentials.json are sensitive and never read
**Default / protected branches**: dotfiles default branch is `main`; ruleset `Default` (active) blocks branch deletion only, so force pushes are not blocked server-side
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None configured; assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet

**Source control**: each repository's own origin remote is its trusted remote; the dotfiles repo receives only its own work; client repos live under ~/Developer/@<client> with per-client git identities
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/Library/Keychains, 1Password group containers, ~/.claude/.credentials.json; any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, or regulated data; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured; fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific

**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development across the dotfiles repo ($HOME), personal projects under ~/Developer, and client work under ~/Developer/@<client>; personal posture in the dotfiles repo, client posture in client repos

**Trusted repo**: the working directory's own repository and its origin; for $HOME that is gabrielecanepa/dotfiles (public), so only this repo's own work is pushed there and public visibility never clears sensitive data into it
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured; local tooling in routine use: nvim, ghostty, brew, claude, codex, gh, mas, mole, oxfmt, biome
**Context separation**: personal, work, and client contexts stay separate; browser, email, and calendar actions target only the active context's accounts
routine dotfiles-maintenance operations (formatting, git status/log, brew, editor and terminal config edits) under $HOME are considered routine
